Name: viewers
Description: Lister viewers: CSV and TSV as a sortable table; JSON, XML and YAML as a tree; e-mails (.eml, .msg), e-books (.epub) and Jupyter notebooks; certificates and programs (.exe, .dll); fonts; contacts (.vcf) and calendars (.ics); the metadata of photos and pictures (EXIF, GPS location, IPTC, XMP).
